name: ppt-minimal-skill-v5
description: DEFAULT deck builder (replaces ppt-minimal-mkl v4). Minimal white classroom-ready .pptx teaching decks from any source: no equation/figure/page/section numbers or footers, every source equation and figure included with derivations and enriched bullets, native editable equations with LHS/RHS colors alternating per equation, 22 pt body, subtitles only where a definition starts, source section names as titles with '(continued)', a title font and color per section, archive-first, Markdown copy, and a tested build chain (pptxgenjs + python-pptx + pandoc OMML) with coverage and layout checks. Skills: `ppt-minimal-skill-v5`.
